text:
zoe: quick PSA 10am chaos: my ferret decided the ethernet patch cable was a chew toy and now my wifi + wired are acting weird. pic of guilty ferret attached. :(
rafael: oh noooo. did it physically cut the cable or just tug it loose?
zoe: nope fully nicked the RJ45 ends. link drops every few minutes. was mid-demo, classic timing.
meera: yikes. temporary fix: plug into another port on your switch/router if available. sometimes the NIC/link resumes on a different port. otherwise replace the patch cable.
josh: local hardware shop usually has cheap Cat6 patch cables. or amazon same-day in some areas. in the meantime, tether your phone.
zoe: swapped to wifi and hotspot for the demo, but jittery. ran a short ping test to capture the behavior:
```
PING 1.1.1.1 (1.1.1.1): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 1.1.1.1: icmp_seq=1 ttl=57 time=18.5 ms
64 bytes from 1.1.1.1: icmp_seq=2 ttl=57 time=22.1 ms
Request timeout for icmp_seq 3
64 bytes from 1.1.1.1: icmp_seq=4 ttl=57 time=21.3 ms
--- 1.1.1.1 ping statistics ---
4 packets transmitted, 3 packets received, 25.0% packet loss
```
meera: 25% loss will wreck screen-sharing. include that snippet in your ticket if you open one. also: put a cable protector or run cable under desk to prevent future attacks.
rafael: pro tip: keep a spare 1-2m patch in your "meeting bag" for these exact moments. labeled, folded, and ready.
jo sh: lol ferret-proofing tip: bitter apple spray works on cords, but check pet-safe options first.
zoe: ordering spares now and bribed ferret with snacks. demo recovered after switching to hotspot + low-res screen share.
ops-bot: reminder: company can ship a loaner hotspot or ethernet cable in urgent cases. file a request in #help with "loaner hotspot" or "loaner cable" and include shipping address.
rafael: also worth noting: if your desktop NIC looks flaky after a short, try restarting the network service or the machine before filing a hardware ticket. sometimes the driver needs a reset.
meera: gif: ferret wearing tiny hardhat :laughing: 
zoe: thanks all 1 saved my demo and the ferret now has a timeout corner. labeling cables and adding a small cable raceway tonight. :raised_hands:
